modules.name: open-design
build-commands:
cat > /app/bin/open-design <<'EOF'
#!/bin/bash
# Open Design Flatpak launcher.
APP="/app/open-design/app-bin"
# The sidecar daemon and spawned agent CLIs expect a reachable session
# bus; flatpak scrubs the variable when it is not set explicitly.
export DBUS_SESSION_BUS_ADDRESS="${DBUS_SESSION_BUS_ADDRESS:-unix:path=$XDG_RUNTIME_DIR/bus}"
# Electron's chrome-sandbox cannot work inside the Flatpak sandbox, so
# apps normally route through zypak (shipped by the Electron BaseApp).
# zypak 26.08 however re-spawns app children inside its own bwrap
# sandbox with a scrubbed environment; this app's sidecar supervisor
# then SIGABRTs in zypak-helper while probing the D-Bus portal
# (DetermineZygoteStrategy). Until that interplay is resolved, disable
# Chromium's INNER sandbox and rely on the Flatpak sandbox as the outer
# boundary (documented in packaging/flatpak/README.md).
export ELECTRON_DISABLE_SANDBOX=1
exec "$APP" "$@"
EOF
chmod +x /app/bin/open-design

cat > /app/share/applications/io.opendesign.desktop.desktop <<'EOF'
[Desktop Entry]
Type=Application
Name=Open Design
GenericName=Open Design
Comment=AI-native design agent workspace (community Flatpak build)
Exec=open-design
Icon=io.opendesign.desktop
Categories=Development;Utility;
StartupWMClass=Open Design
StartupNotify=true
Terminal=false
MimeType=x-scheme-handler/od;
X-Flatpak=io.opendesign.desktop
EOF
